title: Menu Veeran Teriyan, Teriyan Yadan Nai Bohot Sataya
body:
Menu Veeran Teriyan, Teriyan Yadan Nai Bohot Sataya Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ik Khwab Daraunay Nay Beemar Numani Nu, Haye Aan Jagaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaye Ratan Ton Haye Jagdi Paiyan
Khwab Ai Vayi Ay Sochdi Raiyan
Barchi Ton Shuru Hokay Barchi Tay Khatam Hoya
Ki Khwab Ay Aya Ay
<<DIVIDER>>
Kadi Utda Si Haye Kadi Digda Si,
Naal Hathan Day Labda Phirda Si
Rab Janay Keray Gham Nay Meray Babay Di Akhiyan Da
Haye Nour Gawaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran Mera Haye Khat Vi Mera Si
Jo May Akbar Day Naway Likaya Si
Meray Khwab Day Vich Jera Ik Puttar Di Mayyat Tay
Ik Baba Sunaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Koi Dasday Way Haye Khwab Aye Kaisa
Khaak Da Jhoola Tay Nayi Hoonda
Main Takeya Aye Babay Nay Ik Khaak Day Jhoolay Vich
Asghar Nu Sounwaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Sain Khawaban Ch Haye Dar Gayi Akbar
Baaj Veeraan Day Margayi Akbar
Raah Vekhdi Aakhiyan Nu Ik Raat Day Khwaban Nay
Kuj Aina Daraya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Meray Vangoun Aye Haye Hokay Bharda Aye
Tera Jhoola Vi Vain Karda Aye
Menu Aiday Chun Mawan Day Rowan Di Sada Ayi
Main Jad Vi Jhulaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khud Oday Tay Haye Raat Takiya Aye
Teray Auday Chon Paar Hoya Aye
Asghar Nu Pawa Wan Layi May Aayatan Par Par Kay
Jera Jhoola Banaya Aye
<<DIVIDER>>
Menu Daswain Tun Haye Har Ghari Lagda
Veer Jhulay Chun Dig Peya Mera
Menu Lagda Aye Asghar Nu Halmin Di Sada Daykay
Babay Nay Bulaya Aye
